headline: Fire on footbridge in Kakoli, Dhaka, at midnight
summary: The fire occurred late Sunday night, with two fire service units bringing it under control within half an hour. Initial suspicions point to an electrical short circuit.
details: A footover bridge in Kakoli, Dhaka, caught fire late Sunday night. The incident occurred around 2 AM, prompting a swift response from the fire service.
Two units of the Fire Service and Civil Defence brought the blaze under control by 2:30 AM. While the exact cause is unknown, fire officials initially suspect an electrical short circuit.
A significant portion of the footover bridge sustained damage due to the fire. Commuters are currently facing difficulties as the damaged section has not yet been cleared.
caption:
A footover bridge in Dhaka's Kakoli area caught fire in the dead of night, causing significant damage.

A footover bridge in Kakoli, Dhaka, caught fire late Sunday night. The incident occurred around 2 AM, prompting a swift response from the fire service.

Two units of the Fire Service and Civil Defence brought the blaze under control by 2:30 AM. While the exact cause is unknown, fire officials initially suspect an electrical short circuit.

A significant portion of the footover bridge sustained damage due to the fire. Commuters are currently facing difficulties as the damaged section has not yet been cleared.

headline_marked: [[Taapsee Pannu explains why she hasn't shared wedding photos]] after three years of marriage
headline: Taapsee Pannu explains why she hasn't shared wedding photos after three years of marriage
summary: The Bollywood actress, married to Danish badminton star Mathias Boe, kept her wedding a private affair, stating that she sees marriage as a deeply personal matter not meant for public announcement or media spectacle.
details: Bollywood actress Taapsee Pannu has not released any official wedding photos or videos, nearly three years after her marriage to Danish badminton star Mathias Boe. Their wedding was an entirely private event, with no formal announcements from the well-known actress.

The news of their marriage became public in 2024, but the couple provided very few details about the ceremony. While some photos and videos circulated on social media, Taapsee herself never officially published comprehensive wedding pictures or videos.

Recently, Taapsee opened up about her decision, explaining that she considers marriage a deeply personal affair. She stated that she did not feel the necessity to make a public announcement, as she has always kept her personal and professional lives separate.
The actress finds it unusual to publicize such a private moment through press releases or curated photo and video decks. She emphasized her desire to maintain the privacy of her personal life.

Her decision is not solely based on personal preference but also her commitment to her husband, Mathias Boe, who is not part of the entertainment industry. Taapsee does not wish to subject her husband and his family to undue public scrutiny due to her celebrity status.

Taapsee acknowledges that public interest in her work, films, acting, and professional decisions is natural. However, she prioritizes ensuring that this interest does not intrude upon the private lives of her husband and his family.

Taapsee and Mathias share a long-standing relationship, having met through badminton and developing their bond over nearly a decade. They married in 2024 in Udaipur, surrounded by close family and friends, opting for an intimate ceremony over a grand public spectacle.

Her decision to not share wedding photos is consistent with her approach to personal life. Even after marriage, she has largely refrained from discussing private matters, choosing instead to focus on her acting and professional work. She believes it is not a celebrity's duty to share every moment of their personal life with the audience.
